articles.title: What’s making Europe so angry? The frustration behind the protests
articles.description: Protests broke out in France and several European countries as people railed against living costs, poor schooling conditions, and a housing crisis.

articles.title: CNBC Daily Open: Tech rebounds in the U.S., but Asia isn’t buying it yet
articles.description: The Nasdaq Composite gained more than 1% after last week’s sell-off, led by advances in Tesla, Nvidia and Alphabet.

articles.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
articles.description: U.S. Department of Homeland Security has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems.

articles.title: Copper is outshining gold this year. Investors say the rally can survive an AI correction
articles.description: Copper is up 15.8% in 2026 as investors point to AI, grid and national security demand, tight supply and tariff-driven U.S. stockpiles.

articles.title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
articles.description: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.

articles.title: The world’s finance chiefs see new risks — and less China angst
articles.description: Debt, AI and Ukraine dominated the conversation at the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, while China, the focus in 2018, slipped into the background.

articles.title: Sophon sets Nov. 25 withdrawal deadline ahead of mainnet shutdown
articles.description: In June, Sophon’s developers said the costs of maintaining a standalone blockchain no longer justified its benefits and announced plans to focus on consumer finance and AI applications on Base.

articles.title: 'Cannot play hide and seek': Minister's warning over haze sends Singapore agricultural stocks lower
articles.description: Singapore Senior Minister Shanmugam said the Singapore Exchange had questioned seven firms about their operations and possible links to the haze.

articles.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
articles.description: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

articles.title: Bank Indonesia faces mounting pressure to hike after MSCI threat fuels market rout
articles.description: Bank Indonesia faces growing pressure to raise rates after MSCI’s threat to cut its market to standalone status triggered a rout in stocks, weakened the rupiah.

articles.title: BlackRock, GIC among investors chasing Indian telecom major Jio's IPO as anchor bids top $26 billion
articles.description: Jio Platforms plans to raise up to $3.2 billion through an IPO, which is India's largest ever in rupee terms, but the second largest in dollar terms.

articles.title: ‘Open your doors for AI’: German chancellor urges businesses to embrace AI as Nvidia announces new investments
articles.description: Nvidia announced planned investments in four German startups as Chancellor Friedrich Merz urged businesses to embrace AI at an industry summit in Berlin.

articles.title: JD Vance refrains from endorsing Israeli leader Netanyahu as Trump offers praise
articles.description: Vice President JD Vance declined to follow Trump in endorsing Netanyahu, saying he’s “not getting involved in Israeli elections” a week before Israelis vote.

articles.title: Top venture capitalist Jenny Lee says Asian startups are speeding toward IPOs
articles.description: The timeline for startups to do initial public offerings has accelerated, according to Granite Asia's Jenny Lee

articles.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
articles.description: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Navigating a tech-heavy world
articles.description: While economists and former central bankers discuss tech and monetary policy at the Bund Summit, companies are moving faster to capture new revenue.

articles.title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.

articles.title: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares
articles.description: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, and within hours Elon Musk promised a SpaceX share to every American child.

articles.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
articles.description: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

articles.title: Trump says he'd meet with Putin and Xi, criticizes Zelenskyy
articles.description: Tensions between Trump and Zelenskyy have steadily risen in recent weeks, while Russia, which invaded Ukraine, has received multiple breaks from the U.S.
